summary.zh: 用 p5.js 生成可复现的算法艺术作品
summary.en: Generate algorithmic art with p5.js and seeded randomness.

description.zh: 用代码绘制流场、粒子系统等生成式画面，参数可调、随机种子固定后可复现，便于反复比较不同效果。适合视觉实验、插画素材与展示页面。成果是可打开的 p5.js 网页。
description.en: Draws generative pieces such as flow fields and particle systems in code, with adjustable parameters and seeded randomness so results can be reproduced. Suits visual experiments, illustration assets and showcase pages.
